scripts.postinstall: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma generate && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs tsc
scripts.push: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma db push
scripts.push:loss: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.migrate: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:dev: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs prisma migrate deploy
scripts.seed: npm run check:postgres && node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs tsx prisma/seed.ts
